accounting.P: (d+1)*k+1; all floating arrays float64 and ID/age arrays int64
accounting.budget_policy: reserve all named non-fit costs before fitting; choose largest affordable batch <= batch; only the final budget-limited batch may be small
accounting.event_control: 64 per event for counters, bounds and loop control
accounting.excluded: data generation, post-trajectory evaluator, file I/O, audit snapshots and access-counter bookkeeping
accounting.fit_explanation: row term covers forward, gradient and gathers; fixed term covers clipping, Adam, age updates, finite checks and batch control; conservative fixed coefficients
accounting.memory: explicit NumPy array byte inventory and conservative working-array estimate; excludes Python objects, BLAS/eigh internals, audit archives and data owner; not OS peak memory
accounting.model_birth: 4*P_after+5*(d+1), including parameter/moment/variance/age copies and appended entries
accounting.permutation: 4*fit_pool_rows per generated permutation, including any carried epoch tails
accounting.reservoir_update: n*(d+2+8), conservatively charging every incoming row a write plus Algorithm R scalar/RNG work even when discarded
accounting.retention_allocation: capacity*(d+2) plus d*d for historical moment initialization
accounting.retention_comparison: historical128:128*14+144=1936 8-byte words; replay138:138*14=1932 words at d12, a four-word difference; random128 isolates proposal direction at equal replay rows
accounting.unit: declared algorithmic work proxy; not measured or exact hardware FLOPs
accounting.wall_clock: sum measured learner algorithm blocks; audit instrumentation excluded; timer overhead included; process contention may affect wall times
